author: mcp:claude-code
text: Bug: the draft-note box and comment cards used a hardcoded draftBoxWidth = 70. On any pane narrower than that (common once the sidebar eats its share of the terminal), the terminal wrapped the overflowing lines, which broke the box's border into the row below and threw off the row/column bookkeeping rowMeta relies on.

author: mcp:claude-code
text: That's the real root cause behind the earlier symptom where clicks on [Reply]/[+] seemed to land on the wrong target — the click math itself was correct, but the corrupted layout meant the rows it was matching against were no longer where the renderer thought they were.

author: mcp:claude-code
text: Fix: box width is now computed from m.width every render (Model.boxWidth(indent int), floored at minBoxWidth), and the open draft textarea's width is refreshed on every render too, so a live resize can't leave it stale. Locked in with width-invariant tests (assertNoLineExceedsWidth) across pane sizes, including a resize-while-drafting case.

author: mcp:claude-code
text: Takeaway for later phases: any future panel that draws a box (diagram panel in Phase 6, chat panel in Phase 5) must size off the actual pane width, never a constant — this is now the pattern to follow.
